author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Creating animated AI videos can fall apart when dialogue starts, especially when you need realistic lip sync and the same consistent character across multiple scenes.

Try Dzine here: https://dzine.kevinstratvert.com

In this video, I show how to create a short animated commercial using Dzine from start to finish. You will see how to write a simple script, generate consistent cartoon characters, build scenes, add voices, and apply accurate lip sync that matches fast dialogue and multiple speakers. By the end, you will be able to create polished animated videos for ads, explainers, and social content using the same workflow.
